newsitem.title: CANADA: ELAN plans 100 more wells in 1996.
newsitem.headline: ELAN plans 100 more wells in 1996.

text.p: ELAN Energy Inc, which earlier reported sharply higher third-quarter earnings, said on Tuesday it would drill 100 more vertical wells in the fourth quarter.
ELAN said it participated in 19 horizontal and 187 vertical wells in the first nine months of the year.
The company said its drilling program resulted in 171 producing vertical oil wells and 19 horizontal oil wells, including 11 single well steam assisted gravity drainage (SW-SAGD) wells.
Fourth-quarter drilling would be concentrated in the Lindbergh and Cold Lake areas of Alberta, and ELAN's well count for the year was expected to exceed 300, it said.

ELAN said oil and gas liquid production averaged 30,500 barrels a day in the third quarter. Current oil and liquids production was averaging 33,500 barrels a day and the company had 2,200 barrels a day of production shut in, while vertical drilling was occurring on adjacent drilling pads.
Output increases were anticipated over the rest of the year, with five recently drilled SW-SAGD wells coming on stream and upcoming vertical wells placed on production.
